test_policy.notes: Test-optional: the applicant chooses whether SAT or ACT scores are considered. For international applicants an SAT EBRW score of 410 or ACT English 17 can also satisfy the English requirement.

requirements.notes: Apply with Apply IU or the Common App (submit only one). The Common Data Set and the steps page give a $65 nonrefundable fee; the steps page also shows $70 for one international application path (graduate and non-degree), so $65 is the fee shown for first-year applicants. Transcript required; applicants above a 3.0 GPA need only the final high school transcript. International applicants must document finances for a visa.

deadlines.label: International 'apply by' date for Honors College admission-timing and scholarship consideration (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: The page lists December 15 without a year (2026-27 cycle), so December 2026 is assumed for fall 2027. The Honors College application itself is shown as February 15 on the dates page and March 1 on the scholarships page.

deadlines.label: International 'apply by' date to be considered for admissions-based scholarships (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: The page lists February 15 without a year, so 2027 is assumed.

deadlines.label: International 'apply by' deadline, fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: The page lists May 1 without a year, so 2027 is assumed. Domestic fall deadline is July 1 (the Common Data Set lists June 1). Spring entry: December 8.

deadlines.label: Priority date for $100 international enrollment deposit
deadlines.notes: If admitted on or after April 2, the deadline is 30 days after admission.

english_policy.waiver_notes: English can also be shown by completing upper secondary school with at least three years of study in a designated English-speaking country, IU Indianapolis Program for Intensive English (PIE) Level 5, ELS Level 109, GCSE/O Level English language grade C, IB HL English A grade 4, or a C in a U.S. freshman English composition course. Scores must be no more than two years old. Separate IU Indianapolis placement testing (EAP) may apply to some students after admission.

english.notes: New scoring as of January 2026 (1-6 band scale); school code 1325.
Page says 90 for Fall 2026 applications and 95 starting with Spring 2027 applications, so 95 applies to fall 2027.

aid.notes: International applicants are considered automatically for an admission-based scholarship when they apply; scholarship amounts for international students are not published on the pages checked. Students must be enrolled full-time; funds cannot be used for intensive English study. Further scholarships (including Honors College) need separate applications. From the Common Data Set: 117 nonresident undergraduates received aid from the college, averaging $12,369.
